finding: The factorization launches one OpenMP reduction per lower-triangular element (1,181,953 at n=1537), while matrix construction and internal reconstruction remain serial cubic loops. These are plausible sources of excessive runtime; the exact phase at timeout was not observed.
observed_failure: The exclusive 128-thread n=1537 correctness execution exceeds the unchanged 30-second limit without flushed stdout. Its n=513 check passed, while its prior performance benchmark had already failed.
interpretation: Approved supplemental timeout failure, not proof of a numerical error and not caused by two-program scheduling. No retry or limit relaxation.
investigation: Static source inspection and retained exclusive validation output; no new program execution.
